summary: Recorded a source-only refinement with three new anchors: the snapshot route that repairs a wedged follower is only reachable once the leader can no longer read the entries it needs, and compaction keeps the trailing window, so under the defaults (10240 trailing logs, 8192 snapshot threshold) the wedged replica is not repaired that way soon after the wedge - restarts or explicit compaction are what make the repair available.
